portable_archive_validation: Run scripts/verify_release.py on the final ZIP; its SHA-256 and isolated HTTP smoke results are in the external release report, avoiding a self-referential archive hash.
limitations: Native Windows tray/Tk, DPI and default-browser association require target-device acceptance.
120 Hz frame delivery, GPU utilization and audible British speech were not measured.
Personal LM Studio/Google/Azure credentials were not exercised.
Live Bing text search returned only a dynamic shell and Google text search timed out. Search result parsing and shell frame permissions are tested separately with fixtures.
Bing China live 301 evidence precedes the new bounded approved-host redirect handling; the latter is verified with deterministic tests, not claimed as a successful live result.
Other-source cards retain their original language.
Multiple design-style presets and their separate investigation remain deferred.
Responsive checks use real nested browser containers, not native mobile hardware.
Retained online content keeps its original fetch time; explicit Refresh is required for a newer revision.
Existing custom timeout settings are preserved; old short budgets may still expire on slow sources.
Google Images yielded zero public image records on the review-5 live request; Baidu verification observed earlier was not retried. Parser fixtures do not establish live provider availability.
Native split APIs require an optional browser extension and actual browser support; neither installation nor real split execution was performed.
Upgrade verification uses isolated old installations on Linux; Windows CMD, folder selection, tray and automatic browser restart still need target-device acceptance.
The current package contains only the real 0.6-to-0.7 migration; future 0.8/0.9 migration files and GitHub download are not implemented.
